title: Medicare Advantage equity-disaggregation and beneficiary-experience join bridge
purpose: Prevent aggregate MA denial, appeal, contractor, resident, audit, enforcement, quality, or Star Rating surfaces from hiding subgroup harm among dually eligible, LIS, disabled, race/ethnicity, geography, and other vulnerable beneficiary groups.
why_this_is_riskiest: The rev0375 row protects contractor and nursing-home-resident dimensions, but a case can still falsely pass if it averages denial and appeal burden across race/ethnicity, dual/LIS status, disability entitlement, geography, and beneficiary-reported access. The CY2027 Star Ratings rule also blocks relying on a near-term EHO4All/Health Equity Index reward as an active corrective instrument.

substantive_records.source_locator: ResDAC MBSF Base A/B/C/D variable highlights: race, reason for entitlement, monthly A/B/C/D enrollment, dual eligible status, Part C plan/enrollment information, Part D low-income cost sharing; accessed 2026-06-18.
substantive_records.required_join_use: Attach beneficiary denominator attributes to each MA contract/service/month row: race, reason for entitlement, dual eligible status, monthly Part C enrollment, Part C contract/plan, and low-income cost-sharing/LIS proxy where available.
noncertification_limits: race/ethnicity coding and disclosure limits require method notes
does not by itself prove a denial, delay, appeal, or remedy

substantive_records.source_locator: CMS OMH Mapping Medicare Disparities page: tool identifies areas of disparities between Medicare enrollee subgroups in health outcomes, utilization, and spending; accessed 2026-06-18.
substantive_records.required_join_use: Use MMD only as subgroup/place context and measure selection; never as denial or remedy proof. It should flag where a subgroup-specific MA row needs special scrutiny.
noncertification_limits: population/context tool, not request-level prior-authorization data
county or subgroup aggregation can hide contract-specific effects
does not provide contractor or remedy rows

substantive_records.source_locator: CMS MCBS page: beneficiary-reported social/medical risk factors, utilization, health outcomes, linked enrollment/claims, and information not otherwise available through administrative data; accessed 2026-06-18.
substantive_records.required_join_use: Use MCBS or comparable beneficiary-reported evidence to catch access problems, financial burden, unmet need, and health-status changes that administrative denial and appeal rows miss.
noncertification_limits: survey data may lack contract/service specificity
does not replace adjudication or clinical correctness review
response and sample limits require method notes

substantive_records.source_locator: CMS MA & PDP CAHPS page: survey allows objective and meaningful comparisons among MA/PDP contracts on consumer-important domains and is publicly reported; accessed 2026-06-18.
substantive_records.required_join_use: Join CAHPS to contract rows as member-experience context, especially care coordination, plan service, getting needed care, and appeal/friction proxies where available.
noncertification_limits: experience ratings are not service-level denial proof
high ratings cannot offset denied medically necessary care
subgroup sample limits and public reporting granularity must be disclosed

substantive_records.source_locator: CMS CY2027 MA/Part D final-rule fact sheet, Star Ratings section: CMS is not implementing the Excellent Health Outcomes for All reward formerly called the Health Equity Index reward for 2027 Star Ratings; accessed 2026-06-18.
substantive_records.required_join_use: Treat Star Ratings equity correction as absent for this certification window unless another active corrective instrument is shown.
noncertification_limits: does not eliminate all quality reporting or other equity rules
does not tell whether a specific denial was harmful

substantive_records.source_locator: Cross-source bridge from beneficiary denominator, disparity context, beneficiary survey, contract experience, and Star Ratings rule status; accessed 2026-06-18.
substantive_records.required_join_use: A certifying MA claim-security row must preserve subgroup denominator and experience fields alongside request, denial, appeal, overturn, contractor, audit, enforcement, restoration, and payment-integrity fields.
noncertification_limits: still requires acquired data or public pilot row
cannot infer subgroup-specific harm from aggregate denial rates

false_pass_blocks: No aggregate-subgroup pass: overall contract denial or appeal rates cannot certify claim security without dual/LIS/disability/race/geography denominators.
No Star Rating pass: high contract quality ratings or CAHPS scores cannot offset service-level denied medically necessary care.
No MMD-context pass: disparity context can target scrutiny but is not denial, remedy, contractor, or payment-integrity proof.
No survey-only pass: MCBS/CAHPS experience evidence must be joined to administrative denial/remedy rows before certification.
No HEI/EHO4All pass: CY2027 nonimplementation means the archive cannot rely on that reward as an active corrective instrument.
No privacy-suppressed pass: cell suppression, LDS limits, or missing subgroup denominators are blockers, not proof of equity.
No resident-only vulnerability pass: nursing-home status is necessary but not sufficient; dual/LIS/disability/race/geography must remain visible where data permit.
No average-remedy pass: restoration must be measured for the same subgroup/service/contract row, not merely for the aggregate contract.
next_minimum_viable_row: One SNF or other service-specific contract-month row with subgroup denominator fields from MBSF or equivalent, denial/appeal/overturn/remedy fields from Part C/LDS or public rows, contractor/resident fields from rev0375, beneficiary-experience context from MCBS/CAHPS where linkable, MMD/place context, Star Ratings/EHO4All status, audit/enforcement, RADV/payment-integrity, and explicit suppression/method notes.
